capabilities: Toggle light and dark mode from a ribbon icon
Switch to follow-system mode from the status bar
Tint PDF pages soft green in eye-care light mode
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; listed only via BRAT at version 0.1.0. UI labels and commands are partly in Chinese (浅/深/系/护). Scanned or image-based PDFs may not tint well because pages render as canvas.
intentEvidence: diving into Settings every time you want to switch between light mode, dark mode, follow-system mode
motivation: The author built it to remove 'diving into Settings every time you want to switch' between theme modes and to make long note and PDF reading easier on the eyes.
problem: Switching between light, dark, and system themes in Obsidian requires opening Settings each time, and default colors and white PDF pages are harsh for long reading.
summary: Theme switcher that toggles light, dark, follow-system, and eye-care modes from the ribbon or status bar, with softer PDF page styling.
